title: From Modes to Memories: Characterizing the Scale-Space Dynamics of Diffusion Models
title_zh: 从模式到记忆：刻画扩散模型的尺度空间动力学

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models are typically viewed as stochastic processes that transform noise into data. We take a complementary perspective: a diffusion model defines a family of deterministic dynamical systems indexed by noise scale. At each fixed scale σ \sigma , we treat the denoiser as a self-map and study its dynamics. For an exact denoiser, fixed points correspond to critical points of the smoothed data density, while attractors correspond to its modes; as σ \sigma increases, sample-level modes merge into progressively coarser ones. This suggests a geometric view of memorization: examples that receive excess probability mass due to duplication or overfitting, as well as outliers, should remain distinguishable under stronger smoothing than ordinary examples. We quantify this persistence by the critical scale σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} , the largest noise scale at which an example is retained by the fixed-scale dynamics. In conditional models, the same construction extends naturally to image–caption pairs. Experiments in controlled settings and on large-scale models show that σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} tracks memorization arising from duplication, overfitting, and outliers, and identifies both memorized and partially memorized examples in Stable Diffusion. Moreover, σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} yields interpretable measures of the image spatial distribution and caption dependence of memorization.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型通常被视为将噪声转化为数据的随机过程。 我们采取一种互补的视角：扩散模型定义了一个由噪声尺度索引的确定性动态系统族。 在每个固定的尺度 σ \sigma 处，我们将去噪器视为一个自映射，并研究其动态特性。 对于精确的去噪器，不动点对应于平滑数据密度的临界点，而吸引子则对应于其模式；随着 σ \sigma 的增加，样本层面的模式会逐渐融合为更粗略的模式。 这提示了一种关于记忆效应的几何观点：因重复或过拟合而获得额外概率质量的样本以及异常样本，在比常规样本更强的平滑处理下仍应保持可区分性。 我们通过临界尺度 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 来量化这种持续性，即固定尺度动态系统仍能保留某个样本的最大噪声尺度。 在条件模型中，同样的构建方法可以自然地扩展到图像与配文对。 在受控环境以及大规模模型上的实验表明，σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 能够追踪由重复、过拟合和异常样本引起的记忆效应，并能识别 Stable Diffusion 中被记忆和部分被记忆的样本。 此外，σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 还提供了可解释的记忆效应度量，反映了图像的空间分布特征及其对配文的依赖程度。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models are typically viewed as stochastic processes that transform noise into data ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021 ; Karras et al., 2022 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ) . They are trained with a local and static criterion, the prediction of a clean signal from a noisy one at each noise level, and are used through a global and dynamic procedure, a sampler that composes these denoisers along a decreasing schedule of noise levels. What a model has learned is then read off the process as a whole, from its samples or from its loss along the schedule.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型通常被视为一种随机过程，该过程将噪声转化为数据（Ho 等，2020；Song 等，2021；Karras 等，2022；Rombach 等，2022）。 它们的训练基于局部且静态的标准，即在每个噪声水平上从含噪信号中预测出干净信号；而它们的使用则通过一个全局且动态的流程——采样器，该采样器按照噪声水平递减的规划组合这些去噪器。 模型所学到的内容随后可以通过整个过程的样本或其在规划过程中的损失值来读取。

sents.en: Diffusion models are typically viewed as stochastic processes that transform noise into data ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021 ; Karras et al., 2022 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ) .

sents.zh: 模型所学到的内容随后可以通过整个过程的样本或其在规划过程中的损失值来读取。

paragraphs.en: We take a complementary view and interpret a diffusion model as a family of denoisers D σ D_{\sigma} , one for each noise level σ \sigma . Fixing σ \sigma and iterating the denoiser on its own output, x k + 1 = D σ ​ ( x k ) x_{k+1}=D_{\sigma}(x_{k}) , turns a single trained network into a one-parameter family of deterministic dynamical systems , whose fixed points and basins are properties of the network alone (Figure 1 , left). For an exact denoiser each of these maps is Gaussian mean shift on the smoothed data density p σ p_{\sigma} ( Fukunaga and Hostetler, 1975 ; Cheng, 1995 ; Comaniciu and Meer, 2002 ) : its fixed points are the critical points of p σ p_{\sigma} and its attractors are the modes of p σ p_{\sigma} . At small σ \sigma every training example is its own attractor, at large σ \sigma a single attractor remains, and in between the attractors merge into progressively coarser ones (Figures 2 – 3 ). Varying σ \sigma thus traces a scale space of the attractors of the model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采取一种互补的观点，将扩散模型解释为一系列去噪器 D σ D_{\sigma} 的集合，每个噪声水平 σ \sigma 对应一个去噪器。 固定 σ \sigma 并对去噪器的自身输出进行迭代，即 x k + 1 = D σ ​ ( x k ) x_{k+1}=D_{\sigma}(x_{k})，可将单个训练好的网络转化为一个单参数确定性动态系统族，其不动点和吸引盆仅由网络本身决定（图1，左）。 对于精确的去噪器，这些映射中的每一个都是对平滑数据密度 p σ p_{\sigma} 的高斯均值偏移（Fukunaga and Hostetler, 1975；Cheng, 1995；Comaniciu and Meer, 2002）：其不动点是 p σ p_{\sigma} 的临界点，而吸引子则是 p σ p_{\sigma} 的模式。 在较小的 σ \sigma 下，每个训练样本都是自身的吸引子；在较大的 σ \sigma 下，仅剩下一个吸引子；而在两者之间，吸引子会逐渐合并为更粗的吸引子（图2–3）。 因此，通过改变 σ \sigma，可以追踪出模型吸引子的尺度空间。

sents.en: Varying σ \sigma thus traces a scale space of the attractors of the model.
sents.zh: 因此，通过改变 σ \sigma，可以追踪出模型吸引子的尺度空间。

paragraphs.en: This scale space gives a geometric view of memorization mechanisms ( Carlini et al., 2023 ; Bonnaire et al., 2025 ; Ross et al., 2025 ) : an example is retained under its dynamics when it carries excess probability mass, as under duplication or overfitting, or when it is isolated from the remaining data, as outliers. We measure this persistence by the critical scale σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} , the largest noise level at which iterating the fixed-scale denoiser from an example keeps the trajectory close to it (Figure 1 ). The critical scale requires no labels, applies to conditional models, where it becomes a property of a caption-image pair, and is interpretable. We test it with interventions that cause memorization: on CIFAR-10 we induce memorization by duplication, by overfitting and by planting outliers, and on Stable Diffusion we use image–caption pairs that are known to be memorized, fully or in part. Our contributions are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 这种尺度空间为记忆机制提供了几何视角（Carlini 等人，2023；Bonnaire 等人，2025；Ross 等人，2025）：当某个示例携带了多余的概率质量时（例如在复制或过拟合的情况下），或者当它因异常值而与其他数据隔离时，该示例会保留在其动态演化过程中。 我们通过临界尺度 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 来衡量这种持续性，即最大的噪声水平：在该噪声水平下，从某个示例开始迭代固定尺度的去噪器，其轨迹仍能保持与该示例接近（图1）。 临界尺度无需任何标签，适用于条件模型——此时它成为图像与文本描述对的一个属性，并且具有可解释性。 我们通过引发记忆效应的干预手段来检验这一方法：在 CIFAR-10 数据集上，我们通过复制、过拟合和植入异常值来诱导记忆效应；而在 Stable Diffusion 中，我们使用已知被完全或部分记忆的图像–文本描述对进行测试。 我们的贡献如下：

sents.en: Our contributions are as follows:
sents.zh: 我们的贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: We show that a diffusion model can be interpreted as a family of dynamical systems indexed by the noise level: for an exact denoiser the attractors are the modes of the data density smoothed at scale σ \sigma , and varying σ \sigma traces a scale space in which these attractors merge.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，扩散模型可以被解释为一个由噪声水平索引的动力系统族：对于精确的降噪器而言，其吸引子是在尺度 σ 上平滑后的数据密度的模式，而改变 σ 则会描绘出一个尺度空间，其中这些吸引子会逐渐融合。

paragraphs.en: In this framework, we define the critical scale σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} as a memorization measure: the scale up to which a sample remains an attractor of the dynamics. It extends to conditional models, capturing the caption-image interaction. For the optimal case we prove that σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} depends on the inter-samples distances and their multiplicity, reflecting memorization induced by data duplication and outliers.
paragraphs.zh: 在此框架中，我们将关键尺度 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 定义为一个记忆度量：即样本在达到该尺度之前仍保持为动力学的吸引子。 这一方法可扩展至条件模型，从而捕捉到图像与配文之间的相互作用。 对于最优情况，我们证明了 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 取决于样本间的距离及其重复次数，这反映了数据重复和异常值所引发的记忆效应。

sents.en: In this framework, we define the critical scale σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} as a memorization measure: the scale up to which a sample remains an attractor of the dynamics.
sents.zh: 在此框架中，我们将关键尺度 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 定义为一个记忆度量：即样本在达到该尺度之前仍保持为动力学的吸引子。

sents.en: It extends to conditional models, capturing the caption-image interaction.
sents.zh: 这一方法可扩展至条件模型，从而捕捉到图像与配文之间的相互作用。

sents.en: For the optimal case we prove that σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} depends on the inter-samples distances and their multiplicity, reflecting memorization induced by data duplication and outliers.
sents.zh: 对于最优情况，我们证明了 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 取决于样本间的距离及其重复次数，这反映了数据重复和异常值所引发的记忆效应。

paragraphs.en: In controlled experiments we show that σ c \sigma_{c} detects memorization induced by duplication, by overfitting and by planting outliers, transferring the mechanism from the theory to trained networks.
paragraphs.zh: 在受控实验中，我们证明了 σ c \sigma_{c} 能够检测由复制、过拟合以及植入异常值所引发的记忆效应，从而将该机制从理论层面迁移到训练后的网络中。

paragraphs.en: We show that the critical scale is an effective detector on large-scale conditional models such as Stable Diffusion, for both fully and partially memorized examples and that the measures is interpretable : being able to characterize whether its retention comes from the caption, from the image, or their interaction and where in the image the memorized content localizes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明了，对于像 Stable Diffusion 这样的大规模条件模型而言，临界尺度是一种有效的检测工具，既适用于完全记忆化的示例，也适用于部分记忆化的示例。此外，该指标具有可解释性：它能够描述记忆内容究竟是源于图像标题、图像本身，还是二者的相互作用，并进一步定位记忆内容在图像中的具体位置。

paragraphs.en: The first identity is Tweedie’s formula ( Robbins, 1956 ; Efron, 2011 ) , and the iteration of equation 1 is mean shift ( Fukunaga and Hostetler, 1975 ; Cheng, 1995 ; Comaniciu and Meer, 2002 ) , the classical mode-seeking clustering algorithm, run at bandwidth σ \sigma . The attractors of the denoising dynamics are therefore the modes of the data blurred at scale σ \sigma . In the limit σ → 0 \sigma\to 0 every training example is an attractor of its own, whereas once σ \sigma exceeds half the diameter of the data, a single attractor remains, close to the data mean (Proposition B.7 ); at intermediate scales the attractors merge progressively, nearby data into cluster modes and cluster modes into coarser ones. Figure 2 shows the three regimes, and Figure 3 traces the merging as a tree, in which the branch of an example terminates where the example ceases to be an attractor of its own.
paragraphs.zh: 第一种身份是 Tweedie 公式（Robbins, 1956；Efron, 2011），而方程 1 的迭代即为均值迁移（Fukunaga and Hostetler, 1975；Cheng, 1995；Comaniciu and Meer, 2002），这是一种经典的模式搜索聚类算法，在带宽 σ \sigma 下运行。 因此，去噪动力学的吸引子就是数据在尺度 σ \sigma 上模糊化后的各个模式。 在极限情况 σ → 0 \sigma\to 0 时，每个训练样本都是其自身的吸引子；而当 σ \sigma 超过数据直径的一半时，只剩下一个吸引子，且靠近数据均值（命题 B.7）；在中间尺度上，吸引子会逐渐合并：邻近的数据点会聚合成簇模式，而簇模式又会进一步合并为更粗的簇模式。 图 2 展示了这三种状态，而图 3 则以树状结构描绘了这种合并过程，其中某个样本的分支在其不再作为自身吸引子时终止。

paragraphs.en: As σ \sigma increases, a training example is absorbed into a coarser attractor, and the model reproduces only its cluster. We regard an example as memorized to the extent that it resists this absorption: in Figure 3 , non-duplicated examples lose their branch at small σ \sigma , whereas the duplicated example retains it until merging with entire groups. To measure the scale of absorption without locating the attractors, we initialize the dynamics at the example and test whether the orbit remains close to it.
paragraphs.zh: 随着 σ \sigma 增大，一个训练样本会被吸收到更粗略的吸引子中，而模型只会复现其所属的簇。 我们认为，一个样本在多大程度上抵抗这种吸收，就表明它在多大程度上被记住了：在图 3 中，未重复的样本在较小的 σ \sigma 下会失去其分支，而重复的样本则会保留该分支，直到与整个群体合并。 为了在不定位吸引子的情况下衡量吸收的规模，我们将从样本处初始化动力学过程，并检验其轨道是否仍保持与该样本接近。

paragraphs.en: The critical scale is thus the largest noise level at which the model, iterated on its own output, still returns x x : below σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} the example lies in a basin of its own, and above it the orbit is drawn towards an attractor possibly shared with other data. Figure 1 illustrates the definition on a memorized and a control image on Stable Diffusion model: the memorized image is returned over a range of scales an order of magnitude wider than the control, and σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} marks the upper end of this range (the full grid of scales and iterations is in Figure 14 , Appendix G ). Being expressed in units of noise, σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} is comparable across models and noise schedules.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，临界尺度是这样一个最大的噪声水平：在该水平下，模型对其自身输出进行迭代时，仍然会返回 x x；低于 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 时，示例位于其自身的吸引盆中，而高于该水平时，轨道则会被拉向一个可能与其他数据共享的吸引子。 图 1 展示了这一定义在 Stable Diffusion 模型上对一张记忆图像和一张对照图像的适用情况：记忆图像在比对照图像宽一个数量级的尺度范围内都会被返回，而 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 则标志着该范围的上限（完整的尺度和迭代网格见附录 G 中的图 14）。 由于 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 是以噪声为单位的，因此它可以在不同模型和噪声调度方案之间进行比较。

paragraphs.en: For the exact denoiser, the critical scale σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} responds to the probability mass carried by an example and to its distance from the rest of the data.
paragraphs.zh: 对于精确的去噪器而言，关键尺度 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 与样本所携带的概率质量及其与其余数据之间的距离相关。

paragraphs.en: Increasing the probability mass on an example, for instance by duplicating it, reduces the displacement ‖ M σ ​ ( x ) − x ‖ \|M_{\sigma}(x)-x\| at the example at every noise level and can therefore only increase its critical scale.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，通过复制示例来增加其概率质量，会减小该示例在每种噪声水平下的位移 ‖ M σ ​ ( x ) − x ‖ \|M_{\sigma}(x)-x\|，因此只会提高其临界尺度。

paragraphs.en: The map is pulled away from the example only by the other data, and additional mass on the example dilutes this pull. The following theorem makes the rate explicit.
paragraphs.zh: 这张地图仅通过其他数据与示例拉开距离，而示例上的额外质量则会削弱这种拉力。 以下定理明确给出了这一速率。

paragraphs.en: Consider an example of mass θ ≤ 1 2 \theta\leq\tfrac{1}{2} whose only neighbour, carrying the remaining mass, lies at distance d d . The example keeps an attractor of its own exactly below a critical scale, which increases with θ \theta . For small θ \theta this scale grows linearly in the distance and only logarithmically in the mass, as d / 2 ​ log ⁡ ( 1 / θ ) d/\sqrt{2\log(1/\theta)} .

paragraphs.en: Doubling the distance to the neighbour therefore doubles σ c \sigma_{c} , whereas doubling the copies raises it by a few percent. The critical scale thus captures both duplicated examples and outliers. At σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} the attractor disappears in a saddle-node bifurcation, which the escape test detects (Proposition B.12 ).

paragraphs.en: For a single iteration, and when the caption leaves the relative weights of the other examples unchanged, the caption gap of ( x i , c ) (x_{i},c) is positive if and only if the caption raises the model’s mass on that example.
paragraphs.zh: 对于单次迭代，且当标题未改变其他示例的相对权重时，(x_{i},c) 的标题差距为正，当且仅当该标题提升了模型对该示例的权重。

paragraphs.en: The results above concern the exact denoiser, of which a trained network is only an approximation, and we do not expect a trained network to reproduce their values. We expect the mechanism to carry over: an example retains a basin of its own when it carries mass or lies far from the rest of the data, and σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} measures the width of that basin. The experiments of Section 3 verify if memorization from duplicated data and outliers transfers to real data scenarios. On the exact denoiser of a real training set the theory holds quantitatively (Appendix D ), and Appendix D.2 examines how closely trained networks approach it.
paragraphs.zh: 上述结果涉及精确的去噪器，而训练好的网络仅是对该去噪器的近似，因此我们并不期望训练好的网络能够重现这些结果。 我们预期这一机制能够延续：当一个样本包含大量数据或远离其余数据时，它会保留一个属于自己的“盆地”，而 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 则用于衡量该盆地的宽度。 第 3 节的实验旨在验证从重复数据和异常值中获得的记忆能力是否能够迁移到真实数据场景。 在真实训练集的精确去噪器上，该理论在定量层面成立（附录 D），而附录 D.2 则探讨了训练好的网络能够多接近这一理论结果。

sents.zh: 第 3 节的实验旨在验证从重复数据和异常值中获得的记忆能力是否能够迁移到真实数据场景。

sents.en: On the exact denoiser of a real training set the theory holds quantitatively (Appendix D ), and Appendix D.2 examines how closely trained networks approach it.
sents.zh: 在真实训练集的精确去噪器上，该理论在定量层面成立（附录 D），而附录 D.2 则探讨了训练好的网络能够多接近这一理论结果。

paragraphs.en: We first evaluate the critical scale in a controlled setting, with DDPM ( Ho et al., 2020 ) models on the CIFAR-10 dataset ( Krizhevsky, 2009 ) . An example can be memorized for different reasons, but these mechanisms are confounded in pretrained models. We therefore isolate them through controlled training interventions and test whether critical scale detects the memorization induced by each. In all experiments σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} is computed by bisection in log ⁡ σ \log\sigma on the escape event of Definition 3 . Training and evaluation details, and additional results are given in Appendices F and E .
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先在受控环境中评估关键尺度，使用 CIFAR-10 数据集（Krizhevsky, 2009）上的 DDPM（Ho et al., 2020）模型。 一个例子可能因不同原因被记忆，但这些机制在预训练模型中是相互混淆的。 因此，我们通过受控的训练干预来分离这些机制，并测试关键尺度能否检测出每种机制引发的记忆效应。 在所有实验中，σ_c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 都是通过在对数 σ \log\sigma 上对定义 3 中的逃逸事件进行二分法计算得出的。 训练与评估的细节以及补充结果见附录 F 和 E。

sents.en: We first evaluate the critical scale in a controlled setting, with DDPM ( Ho et al., 2020 ) models on the CIFAR-10 dataset ( Krizhevsky, 2009 ) .
sents.zh: 我们首先在受控环境中评估关键尺度，使用 CIFAR-10 数据集（Krizhevsky, 2009）上的 DDPM（Ho et al., 2020）模型。

sents.en: In all experiments σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} is computed by bisection in log ⁡ σ \log\sigma on the escape event of Definition 3 .
sents.zh: 在所有实验中，σ_c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 都是通过在对数 σ \log\sigma 上对定义 3 中的逃逸事件进行二分法计算得出的。

sents.en: Training and evaluation details, and additional results are given in Appendices F and E .
sents.zh: 训练与评估的细节以及补充结果见附录 F 和 E。

paragraphs.en: Duplication (§ 3.1 ). An example is repeated m m times in the training set, so the empirical distribution places mass m / N m/N on it.
paragraphs.zh: 重复（§ 3.1）。 在训练集中，一个例子被重复了 m 次，因此经验分布为其分配了 m/N 的质量。

paragraphs.en: Rarity (§ 3.2 ). An atypical example is added a few times. It has no training neighbours with which to share a basin, but it also receives almost no probability mass.
paragraphs.zh: 稀有性（§ 3.2）。 一个非典型的例子被添加了几次。 它没有可用于共享盆地的训练邻域，但几乎也没有接收到任何概率质量。

paragraphs.en: Overfitting (Appendix E.2 ). The training set is reduced at fixed model capacity and training budget, moving the model from generalization to memorization. σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} tracks this transition and detects memorization at training-set sizes where sampling no longer finds copies.
paragraphs.zh: 过拟合（附录 E.2）。 在模型容量和训练预算固定的情况下，训练集规模被缩减，导致模型从泛化转向记忆。σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 追踪这一转变，并在采样无法再找到副本的训练集规模上检测到记忆现象。

paragraphs.en: We study memorization induced by duplication, and ask whether σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} detects it and how it depends on the number of copies. To isolate the effect of duplication from that of membership, we compare two models trained on the same images: one with duplicates and one without. We train the improved-diffusion CIFAR-10 model ( Nichol and Dhariwal, 2021 ) ( 50 50 M parameters, 500 500 k steps) on the full training set, in which eight images are repeated at each multiplicity m ∈ { 2 , 8 , 25 , 50 , 100 , 200 , 400 , 800 } m\in\{2,8,25,50,100,200,400,800\} . As control we use the publicly released checkpoint of the same model, trained on the same data without duplicates. We evaluate σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} on the 64 64 duplicated images, on 200 200 training images that appear once ( m = 1 m=1 ), and on 200 200 held-out images. Duplication does induce copying: 16 605 16\,605 of 50 000 50\,000 generated samples are copies of a duplicated image.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了由重复引起的记忆效应，并探究了 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 能否检测出这种效应，以及其检测结果如何依赖于副本数量。 为了将重复效应与成员关系效应区分开来，我们比较了两个在相同图像上训练出的模型：一个包含重复图像，另一个则不包含。 我们在完整的训练集上训练了改进扩散 CIFAR-10 模型（Nichol 和 Dhariwal, 2021）（5050 M 个参数，500500 k 步），其中每个多重度 m ∈ { 2 , 8 , 25 , 50 , 100 , 200 , 400 , 800 } m\in\{2,8,25,50,100,200,400,800\} 下都有八张图像被重复。 作为对照，我们使用了同一模型公开发布的检查点，该模型是在相同数据上训练且未包含重复图像的。 我们在 6464 张重复图像、200200 张仅出现一次的训练图像（m = 1 m=1），以及 200200 张预留测试图像上评估了 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}}。 重复确实引发了复制现象：在生成的 5000050\,000 个样本中，有 1660516\,605 个是重复图像的副本。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 a shows that σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} responds to the intervention rather than to the images. In the model trained with duplicates, the median σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} is 0.137 0.137 on held-out images and 0.142 0.142 at m = 1 m=1 , against 1.04 1.04 – 1.43 1.43 for m ≥ 8 m\geq 8 . In the control model the same images have σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} between 0.12 0.12 and 0.27 0.27 at every multiplicity, and the rank correlation with m m drops from ρ = 0.70 \rho=0.70 to 0.19 0.19 . Used as a detector, σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} separates m ≥ 8 m\geq 8 from m = 1 m=1 with Area Under the Curve (AUC) 1.000 1.000 . The duplicated images are fixed points: at m = 800 m=800 the median σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} is the same for K = 50 K=50 and K = 500 K=500 iterations, while for held-out and m = 1 m=1 images it decreases by more than two orders of magnitude over the same range (Figure 4 b). Above m = 8 m=8 , σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} increases by only a factor 1.38 1.38 while m m increases a hundredfold, the saturation expected of a width in which mass enters logarithmically (Appendix E.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 图4a显示，σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 是对干预的响应，而非对图像的响应。 在采用重复样本训练的模型中，保留图像上的 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 中位数为 0.137 0.137，而在 m = 1 m=1 时则为 0.142 0.142；相比之下，当 m ≥ 8 m\geq 8 时，该值介于 1.04 1.04 – 1.43 1.43 之间。 在对照模型中，相同图像在任何多重性下的 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 均介于 0.12 0.12 和 0.27 0.27 之间，且其与 m m 的秩相关系数从 ρ = 0.70 \rho=0.70 下降至 0.19 0.19。 作为检测指标时，σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 能够以曲线下面积（AUC）1.000 1.000 将 m ≥ 8 m\geq 8 与 m = 1 m=1 区分开来。 重复图像是固定点：在 m = 800 m=800 时，无论迭代次数为 K = 50 K=50 还是 K = 500 K=500，σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 的中位数均相同；而对于保留图像和 m = 1 m=1 的图像，在同一范围内该值下降了两个数量级以上（图4b）。 当 m > 8 m>8 时，尽管 m m 增加了百倍，σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 仅增长了 1.38 倍；这与宽度内质量以对数方式进入的预期饱和状态一致（附录E.1）。

paragraphs.en: The critical scale captures memorization from data duplication, which turns transient states in the image orbits into stable fixed points. Additional copies increase σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} only slightly.

paragraphs.en: We study memorization of outliers, which Theorem 5 predicts to be retained with few copies because of their distance to the other samples. We train two models, A and B, on the same subset of N = 10 4 N=10^{4} CIFAR-10 images, to which we add images from 4 datasets of increasing atypicality: CIFAR-10 test images, CIFAR-100 classes with no CIFAR-10 counterpart, SVHN digits, and colourised MNIST digits. The added images statistics are matched to the CIFAR-10 . From each source, 36 36 images are added to A, 36 36 other images to B, and 100 100 images to neither, with six images at each multiplicity m ∈ { 1 , 2 , 4 , 8 , 16 , 32 } m\in\{1,2,4,8,16,32\} . Each image is thus memorized in one model and not in the other, and the images added to neither model serve as a reference distribution. We draw 10 5 10^{5} samples from each model and count near-copies of the added images.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了异常值的记忆问题，根据定理 5 的预测，由于这些异常值与其他样本的距离较远，只需少量副本即可将其保留下来。 我们在相同的 N = 10^4 个 CIFAR-10 图像子集上训练了模型 A 和 B，并向其中添加了来自 4 个异常性递增的数据集的图像：CIFAR-10 测试图像、没有 CIFAR-10 对应项的 CIFAR-100 类别图像、SVHN 数字以及彩色化的 MNIST 数字。 所添加图像的统计特征与 CIFAR-10 的数据相匹配。 从每个数据源中，有 36 个图像被添加到模型 A 中，另外 36 个图像被添加到模型 B 中，还有 100 个图像未被添加到任何模型中，其中每个重复次数 m ∈ {1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32} 对应六个图像。 因此，每张图像都被记忆在其中一个模型中而不在另一个模型中，而未添加到任何模型的图像则作为参考分布。 我们从每个模型中抽取 10^5 个样本，并统计所添加图像的近似副本数量。

sents.en: We study memorization of outliers, which Theorem 5 predicts to be retained with few copies because of their distance to the other samples.
sents.zh: 我们研究了异常值的记忆问题，根据定理 5 的预测，由于这些异常值与其他样本的距离较远，只需少量副本即可将其保留下来。

paragraphs.en: Sampling and σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} have different detection thresholds (Figure 5 ). Sampling detects added images only from m ≈ 8 m\approx 8 , for every source; below this multiplicity no image is generated. We flag an image with σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} when its value exceeds the 95 95 th percentile non-added images from the same source, which gives a false-positive rate of 5 % 5\% without using labels. The resulting threshold decreases with atypicality: m = 8 m=8 for CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 , m = 4 m=4 for SVHN and m = 1 m=1 for colour MNIST . The paired design confirms that the effect is due to training on the image and not to the image itself. Among the added images that were never sampled in the 10 5 10^{5} drawns, σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} flags 88.2 % 88.2\% ( MNIST ), 48.6 % 48.6\% ( SVHN ), 25.6 % 25.6\% ( CIFAR-10 ), and 22.0 % 22.0\% ( CIFAR-100 ). Additional analysis on how σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} depends on distance and on multiplicity in these models is in Appendix E.3 .
paragraphs.zh: Sampling 和 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 具有不同的检测阈值（图 5）。 对于每个数据源，Sampling 仅在 m ≈ 8 m\approx 8 时才能检测到添加的图像；低于该多重性时不会生成任何图像。 当图像中 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 的值超过来自同一数据源的非添加图像的 95 95 百分位时，我们会将其标记；在不使用标签的情况下，这会产生 5 % 5\% 的误报率。 由此得到的阈值会随着异常性降低而减小：CIFAR-10 和 CIFAR-100 中为 m = 8 m=8，SVHN 中为 m = 4 m=4，彩色 MNIST 中为 m = 1 m=1。 配对设计证实，这种效应源于对图像的训练，而非图像本身。 在 10 5 10^{5} 次抽取中从未被采样到的添加图像中，σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 标记了 88.2 % 88.2\%（MNIST）、48.6 % 48.6\%（SVHN）、25.6 % 25.6\%（CIFAR-10）和 22.0 % 22.0\%（CIFAR-100）。 关于 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 在这些模型中如何依赖于距离和多重性的额外分析见附录 E.3。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Stable Diffusion v1.4 ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) on memorized LAION training examples identified by Webster (2023) : matching verbatim (MV) examples, whose generations reproduce the paired training image, and template verbatim (TV) examples, whose generations preserve only part of its content or structure. After removing duplicates and mismatched image–caption pairs (Appendix F ), we retain 70 70 MV and 24 24 TV examples. As controls we use 94 94 training images from LAION-MI ( Dubiński et al., 2024 ) , drawn from LAION Aesthetics v2 5+ ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) , so that all images are training members and differ only in their degree of memorization. Each memorized image is evaluated with its own caption, a swap caption (captions randomly permuted across memorized images) and the empty caption; each control with its own and the empty caption.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Webster（2023）识别出的、来自 LAION 训练集的已记忆示例来评估 Stable Diffusion v1.4（Rombach 等人，2022）：包括逐字匹配（MV）示例，其生成结果能够重现配对的训练图像；以及模板逐字（TV）示例，其生成结果仅保留原图像内容或结构的一部分。 在移除重复项以及图像与说明不匹配的配对后（附录 F），我们保留了 70 个 MV 示例和 24 个 TV 示例。 作为对照，我们使用了来自 LAION-MI（Dubiński 等人，2024）的 94 张训练图像，这些图像选自 LAION Aesthetics v2 5+（Schuhmann 等人，2022），因此所有图像均为训练集成员，仅在其被记忆的程度上有差异。 每张已记忆的图像均使用其自身的说明、一个交换说明（即将所有已记忆图像的说明随机打乱）以及空说明进行评估；每个对照样本则使用其自身的说明和空说明进行评估。

paragraphs.en: From these runs we compute the critical scale σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} under the own caption and the caption gap Δ ​ log ⁡ σ c \Delta\log\sigma_{\mathrm{c}} of Definition 6 , which measures how much the caption increases the retention of that image (Figures 21 – 25 in Appendix G.5 ). We therefore also apply the retention test separately at each latent location u ∈ U u\in U , which gives a local gap Δ ​ log ⁡ σ c u \Delta\log\sigma_{\mathrm{c}}^{u} and the local score 1 | U | ​ ∑ u ∈ U | Δ ​ log ⁡ σ c u | \frac{1}{|U|}\sum_{u\in U}|\Delta\log\sigma_{\mathrm{c}}^{u}| (see Appendix F ). To separate the benefit of spatial resolution from that of discarding the sign, we also report the absolute global gap | Δ ​ log ⁡ σ c | |\Delta\log\sigma_{\mathrm{c}}| . We first evaluate critical-scale scores for detecting memorized examples (§ 4.1 ), then examine whether local gaps identify memorized regions (§ 4.2 ), and finally use mismatched captions to identify images memorized in the unconditional branch (§ 4.3 ).

paragraphs.en: We aim to find images that the unconditional branch has memorized by itself, and not only through their captions. A strongly negative Δ ​ log ⁡ σ c \Delta\log\sigma_{c} indicates stronger retention under unconditional than conditional dynamics. However, since unconditional memorization is rare, searching the full training set for such examples is computationally prohibitive. We therefore use the MV examples under five unrelated captions drawn from LAION-MI, and compute Δ ​ log ⁡ σ c \Delta\log\sigma_{c} for each image-caption pair. This allows us to rank images by evidence of unconditional retention. Since finding an image through unconditional sampling is not feasible, we evaluate this ranking through inpainting. We mask each image quadrant in turn, reconstruct it from the remaining three, and report the mean latent RMSE to the ground-truth region. For each image, we generate 10 samples per quadrant. Low reconstruction error provides evidence that the image is retained independently of its caption.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的目标是找到那些无条件分支仅通过自身记忆而非其描述词记住的图像。 一个显著为负的 Δ log σ_c 表示在无条件动态下比条件动态下的保留能力更强。 然而，由于无条件记忆较为罕见，在整个训练集中搜索此类示例在计算上是不切实际的。 因此，我们使用来自 LAION-MI 的五个无关描述词下的 MV 示例，并为每对图像-描述词计算 Δ log σ_c。 这使我们能够根据无条件保留的证据对图像进行排序。 由于通过无条件采样找到图像并不可行，我们通过图像修复来评估这一排序结果。 我们依次对每个图像的象限进行掩码处理，从其余三个象限中重建该象限，并报告与真实区域相比的平均潜在 RMSE。 对于每张图像，我们在每个象限中生成 10 个样本。 较低的重建误差表明该图像是独立于其描述词而被保留的。

sents.zh: 一个显著为负的 Δ log σ_c 表示在无条件动态下比条件动态下的保留能力更强。

sents.en: However, since unconditional memorization is rare, searching the full training set for such examples is computationally prohibitive.

sents.zh: 由于通过无条件采样找到图像并不可行，我们通过图像修复来评估这一排序结果。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 (right) shows an example with a strongly negative gap. Its unconditional dynamics retain the image more strongly than the mismatched-caption dynamics, and unconditional inpainting accurately reconstructs the missing content. This provides qualitative evidence that the image is memorized by the unconditional branch. This reconstruction is consistent with the memorized image acting as an attractor and the masked image lying within its basin of attraction (see Figure 7 in Appendix A ). Across images, strongly negative gaps are associated with lower inpainting RMSE (top center) and larger unconditional σ c \sigma_{c} (bottom center), supporting their use as evidence of unconditional retention. Gaps near zero are less informative because they can arise when either both dynamics retain the image or neither does. Figure 19 in Appendix G.4 illustrates both near-zero regimes, while Figure 20 provides additional examples with strongly negative gaps.
paragraphs.zh: 图6（右）展示了一个具有强烈负差距的例子。 其无条件动态比不匹配标题的动态能更牢固地保留图像，且无条件图像修复能准确重建缺失内容。 这为图像被无条件分支所记忆提供了定性证据。 这种重建与以下情况一致：被记忆的图像充当吸引子，而掩码后的图像位于其吸引盆内（参见附录A中的图7）。 在不同图像中，强烈的负差距与较低的图像修复RMSE（顶部中央）和较大的无条件σ c \sigma_{c}（底部中央）相关，这支持将其用作无条件保留的证据。 接近零的差距信息量较少，因为它们可能出现在两种情况中：两种动态都保留了图像，或者两者都没有保留。 附录G.4中的图19展示了这两种接近零的情况，而图20则提供了更多具有强烈负差距的例子。

paragraphs.en: A strongly negative critical-scale gap provides evidence that an image is retained independently of its caption, identifying cases in which the image itself contributes to memorization and can be reconstructed by the unconditional branch.
paragraphs.zh: 一个显著的负向临界尺度差距表明，图像能够独立于其标题被保留，从而识别出那些图像本身有助于记忆且可被无条件分支重建的情况。

paragraphs.en: Mean shift turns gradients of kernel density estimates into mode-seeking dynamics ( Fukunaga and Hostetler, 1975 ; Cheng, 1995 ; Comaniciu and Meer, 2002 ) ; with Gaussian kernels, it equals posterior-mean denoising of the empirical distribution, whose smoothed-density critical points are fixed points and modes are attractors. The link between denoising and the score, established for denoising autoencoders ( Alain and Bengio, 2014 ) , underlies score-based diffusion via reverse-time SDEs/ODEs ( Song et al., 2021 ) . These dynamics reveal how structure emerges across noise scales: global high-variance features precede low-variance details ( Wang and Vastola, 2023 ) , a speciation transition marks the emergence of broad structure ( Biroli et al., 2024 ) , and high- and low-level features evolve differently, reflecting the data hierarchy ( Sclocchi et al., 2025 ) . These works follow generation trajectories: instead, we fix the noise scale and iterate the denoiser, obtaining a family of dynamical systems whose attractors and persistence across scales describe the learned structure.
paragraphs.zh: 均值迁移将核密度估计的梯度转化为寻找众数的动态过程（Fukunaga 和 Hostetler，1975；Cheng，1995；Comaniciu 和 Meer，2002）；对于高斯核而言，这等价于对经验分布进行后验均值去噪，其平滑密度函数的临界点为不动点，而众数则为吸引子。 去噪与得分函数之间的联系最初是在去噪自编码器中确立的（Alain 和 Bengio，2014），这一联系构成了基于得分函数的扩散模型的基础，该模型通过反向时间 SDE/ODE 实现（Song 等，2021）。 这些动态过程揭示了结构如何在不同噪声尺度上涌现：全局的高方差特征先于低方差细节出现（Wang 和 Vastola，2023）；物种分化式的转变标志着宽泛结构的形成（Biroli 等，2024）；而高层与低层特征以不同方式演化，反映了数据的层级结构（Sclocchi 等，2025）。 这些研究遵循了生成轨迹的路径；与此相反，我们固定噪声尺度并迭代去噪器，从而获得一个动态系统族，其吸引子以及跨尺度的持续性描述了所学习到的结构。

paragraphs.en: The empirical optimum of denoising score matching reproduces the training data: Gu et al. (2025) study when learned models approach it, and Baptista et al. (2025) how explicit and implicit regularization in the reverse dynamics prevent it. Kadkhodaie et al. (2024) attribute generalization to geometry-adaptive inductive biases, Shah et al. (2025) tie memorization mainly to low-noise denoising, and Bonnaire et al. (2025) show that good generation precedes memorization during training. Closest to us, Fumero et al. (2026a) iterate an autoencoder’s map, whose latent fixed points and attractors reflect memorization and generalization. A diffusion model instead induce a family of dynamical systems, so attractor persistence can be tracked along a scale axis. Pham et al. (2025) view diffusion models as associative memories, and Jain et al. (2025) argue that classifier-free guidance steers reverse trajectories into the basins of memorized images. Both study the reverse generation trajectory, while our fixed-scale dynamics measure how strongly a given image-caption pair is retained across noise scales.
paragraphs.zh: 去噪得分匹配的经验最优解能够复现训练数据：Gu 等人（2025）研究了学习模型在何种情况下会趋近于该最优解，而 Baptista 等人（2025）则探讨了反向动力学中显式与隐式正则化如何阻碍这一过程。Kadkhodaie 等人（2024）将泛化能力归因于几何自适应的归纳偏置；Shah 等人（2025）认为记忆能力主要与低噪声去噪相关；Bonnaire 等人（2025）则表明，在训练过程中，良好的生成能力会先于记忆能力出现。与我们研究最接近的是 Fumero 等人（2026a），他们迭代了自编码器的映射，其潜在固定点和吸引子反映了记忆与泛化能力。相比之下，扩散模型会诱导出一族动力学系统，因此可以沿着尺度轴追踪吸引子的持续性。Pham 等人（2025）将扩散模型视为联想记忆，而 Jain 等人（2025）则认为无分类器引导机制会将反向轨迹导向已记忆图像的吸引盆。这两项研究都关注了反向生成轨迹，而我们的固定尺度动力学则衡量了给定的图像-文本对在不同噪声尺度下被保留的强度。

paragraphs.en: Early work detected replication by matching generations to training data ( Somepalli et al., 2023 ) or extracting training examples ( Carlini et al., 2023 ; Webster, 2023 ) . Later methods avoid exhaustive generation. Wen et al. (2024) detect memorized prompts from the conditional–unconditional noise-prediction gap. Jeon et al. (2025) use probability-landscape sharpness and Ross et al. (2025) the local geometry of model generations to detect memorization. Jiang et al. (2025) address image-level detection without the paired prompt and Chen et al. (2025) localize memorized regions. Our score instead depends jointly on a candidate image–caption pair, testing whether that pair is memorized rather than whether the caption alone elicits memorization. Comparing conditional and empty-caption critical scales further detects memorization in the unconditional branch. Membership inference ( Carlini et al., 2023 ; Hu and Pang, 2023 ; Zhai et al., 2024 ; Duan et al., 2023 ; Matsumoto et al., 2023 ) instead asks whether an example was used in training, not whether it is retained strongly enough to be reproduced.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的工作通过将生成结果与训练数据匹配（Somepalli 等人，2023）或提取训练示例（Carlini 等人，2023；Webster，2023）来检测复制行为。 后来的方法避免了穷举式生成。Wen 等人 （2024）通过条件与无条件噪声预测之间的差异来检测被记忆化的提示。Jeon 等人 （2025）利用概率景观的尖锐度，而 Ross 等人 （2025）则利用模型生成结果的局部几何特性来检测记忆化现象。Jiang 等人 （2025）在没有配对提示的情况下解决了图像层面的检测问题，而 Chen 等人 （2025）则定位了被记忆化的区域。 我们的分数则同时依赖于候选的图像-标题对，用于测试该对是否被记忆化，而非仅测试标题本身是否能引发记忆化。 通过比较条件与空标题下的临界尺度，还可以进一步检测无条件分支中的记忆化现象。 成员推断（Carlini 等人，2023；Hu 和 Pang，2023；Zhai 等人，2024；Duan 等人，2023；Matsumoto 等人，2023）则关注某个示例是否被用于训练，而非其是否被足够牢固地保留以至于能够被重现。

paragraphs.en: In this paper we proposed to interpret a diffusion model as a family of dynamical systems indexed by the noise level, whose attractors form a scale space of the data. Memorization then becomes the persistence of an example as an attractor, measured by the critical scale σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} . On Stable Diffusion, σ c \sigma_{c} detects fully and partially memorized image–caption pairs and offers two forms of interpretation: comparing conditional and unconditional critical scales isolates the caption-image interaction in memorization, while local variants of σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} can identify which regions within an image are memorized. Further analysis is needed to quantify the precision and generality of this localization, which in principle can be extended also to the caption parts. Our theory holds for the exact denoiser. While the mechanism transfers to trained networks (see Section 3 ), closing this gap formally–for instance via analytic models of the inductive biases of trained diffusion models Kamb and Ganguli (2024) –is a natural direction for future work. Beyond memorization, the orbits and basins of the denoising maps may reveal broader structure in what a model has learned Sclocchi et al. (2025) , and locating where individual examples are retained in the weights Hintersdorf et al. (2024) suggests a route towards targeted unlearning.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出将扩散模型解释为以噪声水平为索引的一族动力系统，其吸引子构成了数据的尺度空间。此时，记忆化就表现为某个样本作为吸引子的持久性，其衡量指标为临界尺度 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}}。在 Stable Diffusion 中，σ c \sigma_{c} 能够检测出完全和部分被记忆化的图像-文本对，并提供两种解释方式：通过比较条件和无条件临界尺度，可以分离出记忆化过程中文本与图像的相互作用；而 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 的局部变体则能识别图像中哪些区域被记忆化了。为了量化这种定位方法的精确性和普适性，还需要进一步的分析，从原则上说，该方法也可以扩展到文本部分。我们的理论适用于精确的去噪器。尽管这一机制可以迁移到训练后的网络（参见第 3 节），但正式地填补这一差距——例如通过建立训练后扩散模型归纳偏置的解析模型（Kamb and Ganguli, 2024）——是未来研究的自然方向。除了记忆化之外，去噪映射的轨道和吸引盆可能揭示模型所学内容的更广泛结构（Sclocchi et al., 2025），而确定单个样本在权重中具体保留的位置（Hintersdorf et al., 2024），则为实现有目标的“遗忘”提供了可行路径。

paragraphs.en: This work is primarily theoretical and methodological, focusing on the dynamics of denoising maps and on memorization in diffusion models. All datasets and models are publicly available (CIFAR-10, MNIST, SVHN, LAION-5B ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) and Stable Diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , and the memorized prompts we study were identified in prior work ( Webster, 2023 ) . No human subjects are involved and no new data is collected. Our detectors probe which training images a model has memorized. In principle, such insights could be misused to recover training data from pretrained models. However, our experiments score images that are already public, we release no new private or copyrighted content, and the techniques should be applied responsibly, for instance to audit and reduce memorization. We hope our findings contribute to a better understanding of how diffusion models generalize and memorize.

paragraphs.en: The exact denoiser averages the training data, weighting each clean signal by how plausible it is as the source of x x . Moving to that average moves x x uphill on the smoothed density: the step is the score (Tweedie). How sharply the output reacts to the input is the spread of the plausible sources, i.e. the posterior covariance. So a point is held in place when the posterior at it is narrower than the noise, which is exactly a mode of p σ p_{\sigma} .
paragraphs.zh: 精确的去噪器对训练数据求平均，每个干净信号的权重取决于其作为 x x 来源的合理性。 向该平均值移动会使 x x 在平滑后的密度上向上移动：这一步骤即为得分（Tweedie）。 输出对输入的敏感程度反映了合理来源的分布范围，即后验协方差。 因此，当某点的后验分布比噪声更窄时，该点会被固定住，而这恰好是 p σ p_{\sigma} 的一个模式。

paragraphs.en: At large σ \sigma every posterior is nearly the whole data distribution, so the map barely depends on x x and collapses everything to one point. At small σ \sigma the posterior near a datum is almost entirely that datum, so the map is nearly constant on a small ball around it, which then holds one attractor. Both statements are contraction arguments.
paragraphs.zh: 当 σ \sigma 较大时，每个后验分布几乎覆盖整个数据分布，因此映射几乎不依赖于 x x，并将所有内容坍缩为一个点。 当 σ \sigma 较小时，某个数据点附近的后验分布几乎完全由该数据点本身决定，因此映射在该数据点周围的一个小区域内几乎保持不变，从而仅保留一个吸引子。 这两种陈述都是收缩论证。

paragraphs.en: At the probe, the posterior splits its vote between the probe’s own atom and the rest of the data. Only the rest pulls the probe away, and it pulls with the same force whatever the probe’s mass. More mass on the probe only shrinks the share of the vote the rest receives. The proof makes this exact.

paragraphs.en: With two atoms the map lives on the line through them. There it is a sigmoid of the position, and the sigmoid’s slope is the separation over the noise, β = a 2 / σ 2 \beta=a^{2}/\sigma^{2} , while its offset is the log-mass ratio h h . A steep sigmoid crosses the diagonal three times: one attractor at each atom and a saddle between them. As σ \sigma grows the sigmoid flattens, and the crossing near the lighter atom disappears by merging with the saddle. The lighter atom survives while the slope beats the offset, which is why separation (through β \beta ) enters linearly and mass (through h h ) only logarithmically.
paragraphs.zh: 对于两个原子，该映射存在于穿过它们的直线上。 此时，位置呈现出一个 S 型曲线，其斜率是分离度与噪声的比值 β = a²/σ²，而偏移量则是质量比的对数 h。 一个陡峭的 S 型曲线会与对角线三次相交：每个原子处各有一个吸引子，两者之间还有一个鞍点。 随着 σ 增大，S 型曲线逐渐变平，靠近较轻原子的交点因与鞍点合并而消失。 只要斜率大于偏移量，较轻的原子就会保留下来；这就是为什么分离度（通过 β）以线性方式影响结果，而质量（通过 h）仅以对数方式影响结果。

paragraphs.zh: 稀有性行使用 K = 1 K=1、r = 0.2 r=0.2，而其他行则采用附录 F 中的设置，因此 κ \kappa 在同一块内具有可比性，但在不同块之间则不具备。

paragraphs.en: On the exact denoiser a training image is a fixed point until the saddle-node, so its critical scale does not depend on the iteration budget. On a network it does, and the dependence itself separates the groups: at m = 800 m=800 the median σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} is 1.431 1.431 at both K = 50 K=50 and K = 500 K=500 , whereas for m = 1 m=1 and held-out images it falls by factors of 165 165 and 193 193 over the same range. A memorized image is retained because it is a fixed point of the network’s map; an ordinary image is retained only transiently, and a longer iteration releases it. Consequently κ \kappa compares two escape scales measured the same way, not two maps: at a fixed budget it is a conservative reading of how much of the memorizing solution the network implements, and for images without a basin it is an upper bound rather than an estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 对于精确去噪器而言，训练图像在达到鞍点之前是一个不动点，因此其临界尺度不依赖于迭代预算。 但在网络中则并非如此，这种依赖关系本身就将不同组别区分开来：当 m = 800 时，在 K = 50 和 K = 500 两种情况下，σ c 的中位数均为 1.431；而对于 m = 1 以及预留图像，在同一范围内该值分别下降了 165 倍和 193 倍。 被记忆化的图像之所以得以保留，是因为它是网络映射的一个不动点；而普通图像仅能暂时保留，迭代次数增加后便会释放。 因此，κ 比较的是以相同方式测量的两个逃逸尺度，而非两个映射：在固定预算下，它保守地反映了网络实现记忆化解决方案的程度；而对于没有吸引盆的图像而言，它更是一个上界而非估计值。

paragraphs.en: We study memorization induced by training on a small dataset, and compare σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} with memorization measured by sampling. We train five models with identical architecture, optimiser and training budget on nested subsets of CIFAR-10 of size N ∈ { 100 , 500 , 2000 , 10 4 , 5 ⋅ 10 4 } N\in\{100,\,500,\,2000,\,10^{4},\,5\cdot 10^{4}\} inducing a transition from a memorization (overfitting) to generalization phase ( Fumero et al. [2026b] , Kadkhodaie et al. [2024] , Pham et al. [2025] ). Since only N N varies, a smaller N N means more passes over each image. The first 100 100 images of the permutation belong to every subset, so σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} is evaluated on the same 100 100 training images in every model, together with 100 100 held-out test images. Independently of σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} , we measure memorization as the fraction of generated samples that are near-copies of a training image. We also evaluate the public 50 50 M improved-diffusion model on the same images.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了在小数据集上训练所引发的记忆效应，并将 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 与通过采样测得的结果进行比较。我们在 CIFAR-10 的嵌套子集（大小为 N ∈ { 100 , 500 , 2000 , 10 4 , 5 ⋅ 10 4 } N\in\{100,\,500,\,2000,\,10^{4},\,5\cdot 10^{4}\}）上训练了五个具有相同架构、优化器和训练预算的模型，从而实现了从记忆（过拟合）阶段到泛化阶段的过渡（Fumero 等人 [2026b]、Kadkhodaie 等人 [2024]、Pham 等人 [2025]）。由于仅 N N 发生变化，较小的 N N 意味着每张图片会被多次遍历。排列中的前 100 张图片属于每个子集，因此 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 在每个模型中均基于相同的 100 张训练图片以及另外 100 张预留的测试图片进行评估。独立于 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}}，我们将记忆效应定义为生成样本中与训练图片近乎完全相同的样本所占的比例。此外，我们还在相同的数据集上评估了公开的 50 M 改进扩散模型。

paragraphs.en: The median σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} of the training images decreases by two orders of magnitude, from 4.67 4.67 at N = 100 N=100 to 0.056 0.056 at N = 5 ⋅ 10 4 N=5\cdot 10^{4} , where it coincides with that of the held-out images ( 0.060 0.060 ; Figure 11 a). The decrease is not a power law: σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} is nearly constant up to N = 500 N=500 , collapses between N = 500 N=500 and N = 2000 N=2000 , and is flat afterwards. At both ends σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} agrees with sampling. For N ≤ 500 N\leq 500 , 52 52 – 100 % 100\% of the samples are copies and σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} separates training from held-out images with AUC 1.00 1.00 ; for N ≥ 10 4 N\geq 10^{4} and for the public model, no sample is a copy and σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} is at the held-out level. The two measures differ at N = 2000 N=2000 : only 4 4 of 5 ⋅ 10 4 5\cdot 10^{4} samples are copies, yet σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} separates training from held-out images with AUC 0.897 0.897 (Figure 11 b).
paragraphs.zh: 训练图像的 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 中位数下降了两个数量级，从 N = 100 N=100 时的 4.67 降至 N = 5 ⋅ 10 4 N=5\cdot 10^{4} 时的 0.056，此时它与预留图像的 σ c 值（0.060；图 11a）一致。 这种下降并非幂律关系：σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 在 N = 500 N=500 之前几乎保持不变，在 N = 500 N=500 到 N = 2000 N=2000 之间骤降，之后则保持平稳。 在两个极端情况下，σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 都与采样结果一致。 当 N ≤ 500 N\leq 500 时，52%–100% 的样本是复制品，且 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 能以 AUC = 1.00 区分训练图像和预留图像；而当 N ≥ 10 4 N\geq 10^{4} 以及对于公开模型时，没有样本是复制品，σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 则处于预留图像的水平。 在 N = 2000 N=2000 时，这两种指标存在差异：在 5 ⋅ 10 4 5\cdot 10^{4} 个样本中仅有 4 个是复制品，但 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 仍能以 AUC = 0.897 区分训练图像和预留图像（图 11b）。

paragraphs.en: Every image here appears once, so the training set alone changes little across the sweep: what changes by two orders of magnitude is how closely the trained model reproduces the memorizing solution at these images (Appendix D.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 此处的每张图片仅出现一次，因此仅训练集在整个扫描过程中变化甚微：真正发生两个数量级变化的是，训练后的模型在这些图片上对记忆解决方案的还原程度（附录 D.2）。

paragraphs.en: Retention is lost later than generation: a model can keep its training images as attractors after its sampler has stopped producing them. Since σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} measures retention, it detects memorization in a regime in which the copy rate is already zero.
paragraphs.zh: 保留性比生成出现得更晚：即使采样器停止生成图像后，模型仍可将训练图像作为吸引子保留下来。 由于 σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} 衡量的是保留性，因此它能在复制率已经为零的情况下检测到记忆化现象。

This is consistent with sampling: an exhaustive search finds no extractable training image, and the number of copies remains at the held-out level up to 3 ⋅ 10 5 3\cdot 10^{5} samples. The images that sampling does recover from this model belong to clusters of near-duplicates in CIFAR-10, for which σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} is at the held-out level.

paragraphs.en: Within a source and multiplicity, the increase of σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} caused by adding an image is correlated with its distance to the nearest training image (Spearman ρ = 0.33 \rho=0.33 , p = 5 ⋅ 10 − 5 p=5\cdot 10^{-5} , n = 144 n=144 for m ≤ 4 m\leq 4 ). paragraphs.en: The model with duplicates is trained with the improved-diffusion CIFAR-10 configuration [ Nichol and Dhariwal, 2021 ] , using the model and diffusion definitions of the original implementation: 50 50 M parameters, T = 4000 T=4000 steps with a cosine schedule, learned variances, dropout 0.3 0.3 , 128 128 channels at three resolutions, learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , batch size 128 128 , EMA 0.9999 0.9999 , no horizontal flips, and 500 500 k steps. The control is the released checkpoint cifar10_uncond_50M_500K.pt . Eight images are duplicated at each m ∈ { 2 , 8 , 25 , 50 , 100 , 200 , 400 , 800 } m\in\{2,8,25,50,100,200,400,800\} in addition to the 50 000 50\,000 training images, giving 62 616 62\,616 training examples. The multiplicities are chosen so that m = 800 m=800 corresponds to a per-image mass of 1.28 % 1.28\% . Images in the lowest 5 % 5\% of nearest-neighbour distance within CIFAR-10, i.e. the near-duplicates already present in the dataset, are excluded from both the duplicated images and the m = 1 m=1 images. σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} is computed on the 64 64 duplicated images, 200 200 training images and 200 200 held-out images by bisection on [ 0.02 , 12 ] [0.02,12] with r = 0.5 r=0.5 . Copies are counted with the criterion of Carlini et al. [2023] on 50 000 50\,000 DDIM samples with 100 100 steps, and FID is computed against the training set with 50 000 50\,000 samples per model. The two models are not exactly matched: the held-out loss of the model with duplicates is 1 1 – 4.5 % 4.5\% higher than that of the released checkpoint at every t t , and its gap between training and held-out loss is about 5 % 5\% , against 0.8 % 0.8\% for the released model, although it sees each non-duplicated image 20 % 20\% less often. The released checkpoint should therefore be regarded as a reference trained without duplicates rather than as an exactly matched control.

Since σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} on CIFAR-10 depends strongly on ‖ x ‖ \|x\| and on typicality, unmatched images would obtain high values for trivial reasons; the added images are therefore matched to the base set in RMS norm and total variation, and images with a near-duplicate in the CIFAR-10 training set are excluded. A sample is a copy when its nearest image among the CIFAR-10 training set and all images of the four sources is at RMS distance below 0.07 0.07 on [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , and below 0.45 0.45 times the mean distance to the next 50 50 images; no image that was not added to a model was copied in 2 ⋅ 10 5 2\cdot 10^{5} samples. σ c \sigma_{\mathrm{c}} is computed with K = 1 K=1 and r = 0.2 r=0.2 by bisection on the range of the noise schedule up to σ = 20 \sigma=20 , with 14 14 steps.
paragraphs.zh: 基础集合包含来自同一排列的 N = 10⁴ 张图像，模型使用相同的架构和 15k 次训练步骤。 新增的图像使每个训练集的样本数量达到 11,512 个。 由于 CIFAR-10 上的 σ_c 强烈依赖于 ‖x‖ 和典型性，不匹配的图像会因无关紧要的原因获得高值；因此，新增图像在 RMS 范数和总变差上与基础集合进行匹配，并且排除 CIFAR-10 训练集中存在近似重复项的图像。 彩色 MNIST 无法完全匹配（RMS 为 0.56 对比 0.49，总变差为 0.038 对比 0.056），应被视为非典型性范围的极端情况。 我们为每个模型抽取 10⁵ 个 DDIM 样本（η = 1，100 步）。 当一个样本在最近邻图像（来自 CIFAR-10 训练集和四个来源的所有图像）上的 RMS 距离低于 [0,1] 范围内的 0.07，且低于与接下来 50 张图像平均距离的 0.45 倍时，该样本即为复制品；在 2×10⁵ 个样本中，没有未添加到模型中的图像被复制。σ_c 通过二分法在噪声调度范围内（直至 σ = 20）计算，其中 K = 1、r = 0.2，共 14 步。

paragraphs.en: For the Stable Diffusion experiments, we use the matching-verbatim (MV) and template-verbatim (TV) examples released by Webster [2023] . The collection contains many duplicate or near-duplicate entries, particularly among the TV examples, where the same memorized template appears with different visual patterns. To prevent these repeated templates from being overrepresented in our evaluation, we manually deduplicate the collection, retaining one MV copy per image and one TV example per template. We additionally remove a small number of mismatched image–caption pairs. The released collection associates each memorized image with its training caption, but does not guarantee that sampling from that caption reproduces that particular image. In several cases, the stored caption instead reproduces a different memorized image. Because our method evaluates memorization at the level of image–caption pairs, we exclude these mismatches. Figure 13 shows representative examples removed by both filtering steps.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Stable Diffusion 实验中，我们使用了 Webster [2023] 发布的逐字匹配（MV）和模板逐字（TV）示例。 该数据集包含许多重复或近乎重复的条目，尤其是在 TV 示例中，相同的记忆模板会伴随不同的视觉模式出现。 为防止这些重复模板在我们的评估中被过度代表，我们手动去除了数据集中的重复项，每张图片保留一份 MV 副本，每个模板保留一个 TV 示例。 此外，我们还移除了少量不匹配的图片-描述对。 已发布的数据集将每张记忆图片与其训练描述关联起来，但并不保证从该描述中采样能重现这张特定的图片。 在某些情况下，存储的描述反而会重现另一张不同的记忆图片。 由于我们的方法是在图片-描述对层面评估记忆能力，因此我们排除了这些不匹配的情况。 图 13 展示了通过这两步筛选被移除的代表性示例。

paragraphs.en: Figures 15 and 16 assess sensitivity to the number of iterations K K and escape radius r r . Performance is stable around our primary choices: K = 16 K=16 , with r = 0.25 r=0.25 for global scores and r = 0.1 r=0.1 for the local gap.
paragraphs.zh: 图 15 和图 16 评估了对迭代次数 K 和逃逸半径 r 的敏感性。 在主要参数选择附近，性能表现稳定：全局得分对应的参数为 K = 16、r = 0.25，局部差距对应的参数为 r = 0.1。

sents.en: Figures 15 and 16 assess sensitivity to the number of iterations K K and escape radius r r .
sents.zh: 图 15 和图 16 评估了对迭代次数 K 和逃逸半径 r 的敏感性。

sents.en: Performance is stable around our primary choices: K = 16 K=16 , with r = 0.25 r=0.25 for global scores and r = 0.1 r=0.1 for the local gap.
sents.zh: 在主要参数选择附近，性能表现稳定：全局得分对应的参数为 K = 16、r = 0.25，局部差距对应的参数为 r = 0.1。

paragraphs.en: For r = 0.25 r=0.25 , the global scores remain broadly stable through K = 64 K=64 and deteriorate at larger values. With r = 0.1 r=0.1 , their performance is lower and begins to decline earlier; this sensitivity is particularly pronounced for σ c \sigma_{c} on TV examples. By contrast, the local gap performs similarly for both radii across most values of K K , with only a modest decline beyond K = 128 K=128 . Noticeably, mean σ c \sigma_{c} decreases with K K , reducing separation between memorized and control examples and causing the drop in detection performance at large K K .

paragraphs.en: The caption-swap distributions illustrate why the sign of the gap matters. Most swapped pairs have a negative gap, indicating that an unrelated caption weakens retention relative to the unconditional branch; this behavior is especially frequent for TV examples. Taking the absolute value folds these negative scores onto the positive axis, obscuring the separation between original and swapped pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 标题交换分布说明了差距符号的重要性。 大多数被交换的配对都具有负差距，这表明无关的标题会削弱与无条件分支相比的记忆保持效果；在电视示例中，这种现象尤为频繁。 取绝对值会将这些负分折叠到正轴上，从而掩盖原始配对与交换配对之间的区别。

paragraphs.en: Figure 18 presents four additional TV examples. As in Figure 6 (left), large local gaps align with content reproduced consistently across generations, whereas regions that vary tend to have gaps near zero. These examples further show that the local critical-scale gap captures the spatial extent of memorized content across different images.
paragraphs.zh: 图 18 展示了另外四个电视示例。 与图 6（左侧）的情况一样，较大的局部间隙与跨代一致再现的内容相对应，而存在变化的区域则倾向于具有接近零的间隙。 这些示例进一步表明，局部临界尺度间隙能够捕捉不同图像中记忆内容在空间上的分布范围。

sents.en: Figure 18 presents four additional TV examples.
sents.zh: 图 18 展示了另外四个电视示例。

sents.en: As in Figure 6 (left), large local gaps align with content reproduced consistently across generations, whereas regions that vary tend to have gaps near zero.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 6 (right), the gap between mismatched-caption and unconditional critical scales is most informative when strongly negative. Values near zero, however, can represent two different regimes. Both branches may retain the image, indicating unconditional memorization and therefore yielding successful inpainting, or neither branch may retain it, indicating the absence of unconditional memorization. Because the gap measures relative retention, it cannot distinguish between these cases. Figure 19 (top) illustrates the first regime and Figure 19 (bottom) the second: despite having similar gaps, the examples have markedly different critical scales and inpainting performance.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 6（右）所示，当不匹配标题与无条件关键尺度之间的差距为强负值时，该差距最具信息量。 然而，接近零的数值可能代表两种不同的机制。 两个分支都可能保留图像，表明存在无条件的记忆，从而成功实现图像修复；或者两个分支都不保留图像，表明不存在无条件的记忆。 由于该差距衡量的是相对保留程度，因此无法区分这两种情况。 图 19（上）展示了第一种机制，图 19（下）展示了第二种机制：尽管这些示例的差距相似，但它们的关键尺度和图像修复效果却明显不同。

paragraphs.en: Figure 20 provides two further examples with negative gaps. Both show evidence of unconditional memorization, but the example with the more negative gap yields more faithful reconstructions, consistent with stronger relative retention by the unconditional branch.

paragraphs.en: Figures 21 – 23 provide additional comparisons of fixed-scale trajectories and critical scales for matching-verbatim (MV), template-verbatim (TV), and control training images. Overall, retention is strongest for MV examples, followed by TV examples and then randomly selected controls: MV images remain close to their initial states for more iterations and at larger noise scales than TV images, which in turn persist longer than controls.
paragraphs.zh: 图 21–23 提供了固定规模轨迹与匹配逐字（MV）、模板逐字（TV）及对照训练图像的临界规模的额外比较。 总体而言，MV 示例的保留能力最强，其次是 TV 示例，最后是随机选定的对照图像：MV 图像在更多迭代和更大的噪声规模下仍能保持接近其初始状态，而 TV 图像则比对照图像存在得更久。

sents.en: Figures 21 – 23 provide additional comparisons of fixed-scale trajectories and critical scales for matching-verbatim (MV), template-verbatim (TV), and control training images.
sents.zh: 图 21–23 提供了固定规模轨迹与匹配逐字（MV）、模板逐字（TV）及对照训练图像的临界规模的额外比较。

sents.en: Overall, retention is strongest for MV examples, followed by TV examples and then randomly selected controls: MV images remain close to their initial states for more iterations and at larger noise scales than TV images, which in turn persist longer than controls.
sents.zh: 总体而言，MV 示例的保留能力最强，其次是 TV 示例，最后是随机选定的对照图像：MV 图像在更多迭代和更大的噪声规模下仍能保持接近其初始状态，而 TV 图像则比对照图像存在得更久。

paragraphs.en: The TV trajectories also reveal spatial differences in retention. In the bedroom example of Figures 23 and 25 , the surrounding room remains stable after the bedsheet pattern has been smoothed, consistent with the memorized and variable regions identified in Figure 18 . Similarly, in Figure 22 , the non-memorized curtain pattern disappears first, whereas the memorized plant and chair persist longer. These examples provide qualitative evidence that fixed-scale dynamics retain memorized regions longer than non-memorized ones, further motivating a local measure for partially memorized images.
paragraphs.zh: 电视轨迹也揭示了保留方面的空间差异。 在图 23 和图 25 的卧室示例中，床单图案被平滑处理后，周围房间保持稳定，这与图 18 中识别出的记忆区域和可变区域一致。 同样，在图 22 中，未记忆的窗帘图案最先消失，而记忆的植物和椅子则保留得更久。 这些例子提供了定性证据，表明固定尺度动力学比非记忆区域更长时间地保留记忆区域，这进一步为部分记忆图像提出局部度量提供了依据。
